strings.cc2moodle_req_auth: ERROR: The Common Cartridge package requires authorization.
strings.cc_import_req_dom: ERROR: The Common Cartridge import requires DOM extension.
strings.cc_import_req_libxml: ERROR: The Common Cartridge import requires LIBXML extension.
strings.cc_import_req_libxmlminversion: ERROR: The Common Cartridge import requires LIBXML version 2.6.30 or newer.
strings.cc_import_req_php5: ERROR: The Common Cartridge import requires PHP 5 or higher.
strings.cc_import_req_xsl: ERROR: The Common Cartridge import requires XSL.
strings.enable_cc_import_description: This setting enables the import of Common Cartridge (IMS-CC) packages using the standard restore functionality. Note it requires PHP5, DOM, XSL and LIBXML (2.6.30 or newer) extensions to be installed in the server.
